headline: DeepSeek launches autonomous coding agent to compete with Anthropic's Claude Code
summary: Artificial intelligence model provider DeepSeek has launched an autonomous coding agent aimed at challenging Anthropic's Claude Code tool.
why: DeepSeek and Anthropic are leading developers of artificial intelligence systems, competing heavily in automated software development tools.

impacts.name: DeepSeek
impacts.why: DeepSeek introduced a new coding agent product directly targetting competitive tools in software development.
